title: Annotated Image Spec
description: Spec for the annotated_image envelope type. Used when the visual artifact is a user-uploaded image (drag-drop, paste, or file upload) overlaid with AI-emitted annotations at normalized image-relative coordinates. The actual annotation entries live on the envelope's top-level `annotations` array (with x/y instead of target_id). The spec block carries only the backdrop-source metadata.

kind.description: Where the backdrop image comes from. 'user_upload' references the image the user attached this turn — already present on the visual panel's backgroundLayer.

natural_width.description: Optional. Natural pixel width of the source image. The renderer reads bounds from the live Konva.Image node — this field is informational only.
